+
+function sourceEvidenceForValidatorResult({ result, paths, pointer }) {

+    evidence_families: result.evidence_families ?? [],
+    question_context: result.question_context ?? null,
+    confidence: {
+      confidence_band: result.confidence_band ?? null,
+      confidence_score: result.confidence_score ?? null,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function sourceEvidenceForTaxonomyTask({ task, paths, pointer }) {
+  return {
+    source_artifact_refs: [
+      {
+        path: paths.taxonomyReviewQueue,
+        json_pointer: pointer,
+      },
+    ],
+    source_review_task_id: task.review_task_id ?? null,
+    task_kind: task.task_kind ?? null,
+    decision_ref: task.decision_ref ?? null,
+    validator_reason_codes: task.reason_codes ?? [],
+    candidate_ids: task.candidate_ids ?? [],
+    candidate_labels: task.candidate_labels ?? [],
+    ambiguous_between_predicates: task.ambiguous_between_predicates ?? [],

+function buildValidatorReviewTask({
+  result,
+  resultKind,
+  resultIndex,
+  paths,
+  rubric,

+  return {
+    review_task_id: reviewTaskId,
+    queue_category: categoryId,
+    queue_lane: queueLane,
+    review_state: 'unresolved',
+    source_kind: 'triangulation_validator_result',
+    source_result_kind: resultKind,
+    source_assertion_id: result.assertion_id ?? null,
+    source_validator_route: result.validator_route ?? null,

+    risk_tier: riskTier,
+    predicate: result.predicate ?? null,

+    reason_codes: reasonCodesFromResult(result),
+    reason_families: reasonFamiliesFromResult(result),
+    source_evidence: sourceEvidence,
+    allowed_decision_statuses: DECISION_STATUS_OPTIONS,

+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      rubric,
+    }),
+    downstream_action_options: DOWNSTREAM_ACTION_OPTIONS,
+    decision_schema_ref: DEFAULT_PATHS.decisionSchemaOut,
+  };
+}
+
+function buildTaxonomyReviewTask({
+  task,
+  taskIndex,
+  paths,
+  rubric,
+}) {
+  const categoryId = categoryForTaxonomyTask(task);
+  const queueLane = 'semantic_review';
+  const riskTier = MEDIUM_RISK_TIER;
+  const reviewTaskId = `semrev:1335:taxonomy:${slugify(task.review_task_id)}`;
+  const pointer = `/review_tasks/${taskIndex}`;
+  const sourceEvidence = sourceEvidenceForTaxonomyTask({ task, paths, pointer });
+
+  return {
+    review_task_id: reviewTaskId,
+    queue_category: categoryId,
+    queue_lane: queueLane,
+    review_state: 'unresolved',
+    source_kind: 'taxonomy_canonicalization_review_task',
+    source_review_task_id: task.review_task_id ?? null,
+    source_validator_route: 'taxonomy_review_queue',
+    required_reviewer_role: task.required_reviewer_role ?? 'taxonomy_owner',
+    reviewer_agreement_requirement: reviewerAgreementRequirement({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      queueLane,
+    }),
+    priority: priorityForTask({ categoryId, riskTier, queueLane }),
+    risk_tier: riskTier,
+    predicate: null,
+    status_at_queue_generation: task.review_state ?? null,
+    confidence_band: null,
+    promotion_allowed: false,
+    auto_promotion_blocked: true,
+    requires_human_adjudication: true,
+    reason_codes: uniqueSorted(task.reason_codes ?? []),
+    reason_families: ['taxonomy_canonicalization'],
+    source_evidence: sourceEvidence,
+    allowed_decision_statuses: DECISION_STATUS_OPTIONS,
+    allowed_decision_reason_codes: allowedDecisionReasonCodes({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      rubric,
+    }),
+    downstream_action_options: DOWNSTREAM_ACTION_OPTIONS,
+    decision_schema_ref: DEFAULT_PATHS.decisionSchemaOut,
+  };
+}
+
+function queueableValidatorResults(triangulationValidatorResult) {
+  const fixtureResults = Array.isArray(triangulationValidatorResult?.fixture_results)
+    ? triangulationValidatorResult.fixture_results
+    : [];
+  const rawCandidateResults = Array.isArray(triangulationValidatorResult?.raw_candidate_results)
+    ? triangulationValidatorResult.raw_candidate_results
+    : [];
+
+  return [
+    ...fixtureResults
+      .map((result, index) => ({ result, resultKind: 'fixture_results', resultIndex: index }))
+      .filter(({ result }) => ['review_required', 'blocked_quarantined'].includes(result.validator_route)),
+    ...rawCandidateResults
+      .map((result, index) => ({ result, resultKind: 'raw_candidate_results', resultIndex: index }))
+      .filter(({ result }) => ['review_required', 'blocked_quarantined'].includes(result.validator_route)),
+  ];
+}
+
+function buildReviewTasks({ inputs, paths, rubric }) {
+  const validatorTasks = queueableValidatorResults(inputs.triangulationValidatorResult)
+    .map(({ result, resultKind, resultIndex }) => buildValidatorReviewTask({
+      result,
+      resultKind,
+      resultIndex,
+      paths,
+      rubric,
+    }));
+  const taxonomyTasks = (inputs.taxonomyReviewQueue?.review_tasks ?? [])
+    .map((task, taskIndex) => buildTaxonomyReviewTask({
+      task,
+      taskIndex,
+      paths,
+      rubric,
+    }));
+
+  return [...validatorTasks, ...taxonomyTasks]
+    .sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.review_task_id, right.review_task_id));
+}

+      review_decision_id: 'REVIEW_DECISION_ID_PLACEHOLDER',
+      review_task_id: 'REVIEW_TASK_ID_PLACEHOLDER',
+      reviewer_identity: {
+        reviewer_id: 'REVIEWER_ID_PLACEHOLDER',
+        reviewer_role: 'REVIEWER_ROLE_PLACEHOLDER',
+      },
+      decision_status: 'DECISION_STATUS_PLACEHOLDER',
+      reason_code: 'REASON_CODE_PLACEHOLDER',
+      source_evidence: {
+        source_artifact_refs: [
+          {
+            path: 'SOURCE_ARTIFACT_PATH_PLACEHOLDER',
+            json_pointer: 'SOURCE_JSON_POINTER_PLACEHOLDER',
+          },
+        ],
+      },
+      decided_at: 'TIMESTAMP_PLACEHOLDER_ISO_8601',
+      downstream_action: 'DOWNSTREAM_ACTION_PLACEHOLDER',
+      reviewer_notes: 'OPTIONAL_REVIEWER_NOTES_PLACEHOLDER',
+    },
+    output_artifact_path: paths.decisionSchemaOut,
+  };
+}
+
+function categoryForValidatorResult(result) {
+  const codes = new Set(reasonCodesFromResult(result));
+  const families = new Set(reasonFamiliesFromResult(result));
+  const predicate = result.predicate ?? '';
+
+  if (predicate.includes('mastery') || codes.has('blocked_mastery_overclaim')) {
+    return 'mastery_overclaim';
+  }
+  if (
+    codes.has('method_evidence_blocked_or_quarantined') ||
+    (
+      result.validator_route === 'blocked_quarantined' &&
+      families.has('blocked_quarantined')
+    )
+  ) {
+    return 'blocked_quarantined_evidence';
+  }
+  if (codes.has('over_broad_concept_requires_review')) {
+    return 'broad_topic_overtag';
+  }
+  if (
+    codes.has('contradictory_evidence_requires_review') ||
+    codes.has('semantic_contrast_requires_review') ||
+    codes.has('wrong_topic_family_or_visual_similarity_requires_review')
+  ) {
+    return 'contradiction';
+  }
+  if (
+    codes.has('reversed_prerequisite_direction_requires_review') ||
+    predicate.includes('prerequisite')
+  ) {
+    return 'prerequisite_direction_risk';
+  }
+  if (
+    codes.has('misconception_over_claim_requires_review') ||
+    predicate.includes('misconception')
+  ) {
+    return 'unsupported_misconception';
+  }
+  if (
+    families.has('evidence_strength') ||
+    families.has('source_state') ||
+    families.has('confidence') ||
+    codes.has('low_confidence_candidate_requires_review')
+  ) {
+    return 'insufficient_provenance';
+  }
+  return 'status_transition_adjudication';
+}
+
+function categoryForTaxonomyTask(task) {
+  if (
+    Array.isArray(task.ambiguous_between_predicates) &&
+    task.ambiguous_between_predicates.some((predicate) => String(predicate).includes('procedure'))
+  ) {
+    return 'alternative_method_ambiguity';
+  }
+  return 'noncanonical_label';
+}
+
+function reviewerAgreementRequirement({ categoryId, riskTier, queueLane }) {
+  if (queueLane === 'blocked_quarantined_semantic_evidence') {
+    return 'semantic_governance_owner_required';
+  }
+  if (riskTier === HIGH_RISK_TIER || [
+    'mastery_overclaim',
+    'prerequisite_direction_risk',
+    'unsupported_misconception',
+  ].includes(categoryId)) {
+    return 'two_reviewer_or_semantic_governance_owner_tie_break';
+  }
+  if (categoryId === 'alternative_method_ambiguity') {
+    return 'single_semantic_owner_with_taxonomy_owner_escalation';
+  }
+  return 'single_semantic_owner';
+}
+
+function priorityForTask({ categoryId, riskTier, queueLane }) {
+  if (queueLane === 'blocked_quarantined_semantic_evidence') return 'p0_blocker';
+  if (riskTier === HIGH_RISK_TIER) return 'p1_high_risk';
+  if ([
+    'broad_topic_overtag',
+    'contradiction',
+    'prerequisite_direction_risk',
+    'unsupported_misconception',
+  ].includes(categoryId)) {
+    return 'p1_review_before_pilot';
+  }
+  return 'p2_pilot_burden_measurement';
+}
+
+function allowedDecisionReasonCodes({ categoryId, riskTier, rubric }) {
+  const categoryCodes = CATEGORY_DECISION_REASON_CODES[categoryId] ?? [];
+  const riskRuleCodes = Object.values(rubric.risk_tier_status_rules[riskTier] ?? {})
+    .flatMap((rule) => rule.machine_reason_codes ?? []);
+  return uniqueSorted([...categoryCodes, ...riskRuleCodes]);
+}
+
+function sourceEvidenceForValidatorResult({ result, paths, pointer }) {
+  return {
+    source_artifact_refs: [
+      {
+        path: paths.triangulationValidatorResult,
+        json_pointer: pointer,
+      },
+    ],
+    source_assertion_id: result.assertion_id ?? null,
+    predicate: result.predicate ?? null,
+    status: result.status ?? null,
+    risk_tier: result.risk_tier ?? null,
+    validator_route: result.validator_route ?? null,
+    validator_reason_codes: reasonCodesFromResult(result),
+    evidence_families: result.evidence_families ?? [],
+    question_context: result.question_context ?? null,
+    confidence: {
+      confidence_band: result.confidence_band ?? null,
+      confidence_score: result.confidence_score ?? null,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function sourceEvidenceForTaxonomyTask({ task, paths, pointer }) {
+  return {
+    source_artifact_refs: [
+      {
+        path: paths.taxonomyReviewQueue,
+        json_pointer: pointer,
+      },
+    ],
+    source_review_task_id: task.review_task_id ?? null,
+    task_kind: task.task_kind ?? null,
+    decision_ref: task.decision_ref ?? null,
+    validator_reason_codes: task.reason_codes ?? [],
+    candidate_ids: task.candidate_ids ?? [],
+    candidate_labels: task.candidate_labels ?? [],
+    ambiguous_between_predicates: task.ambiguous_between_predicates ?? [],
+  };
+}
+
+function buildValidatorReviewTask({
+  result,
+  resultKind,
+  resultIndex,
+  paths,
+  rubric,
+}) {
+  const categoryId = categoryForValidatorResult(result);
+  const queueLane = result.review_routing?.queue ?? 'semantic_review';
+  const riskTier = result.risk_tier ?? MEDIUM_RISK_TIER;
+  const reviewTaskId = `semrev:1335:validator:${slugify(result.assertion_id)}`;
+  const pointer = `/${resultKind}/${resultIndex}`;
+  const sourceEvidence = sourceEvidenceForValidatorResult({ result, paths, pointer });
+
+  return {
+    review_task_id: reviewTaskId,
+    queue_category: categoryId,
+    queue_lane: queueLane,
+    review_state: 'unresolved',
+    source_kind: 'triangulation_validator_result',
+    source_result_kind: resultKind,
+    source_assertion_id: result.assertion_id ?? null,
+    source_validator_route: result.validator_route ?? null,
+    required_reviewer_role:
+      result.review_routing?.required_reviewer_role ?? 'semantic_taxonomy_owner',
+    reviewer_agreement_requirement: reviewerAgreementRequirement({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      queueLane,
+    }),
+    priority: priorityForTask({ categoryId, riskTier, queueLane }),
+    risk_tier: riskTier,
+    predicate: result.predicate ?? null,
+    status_at_queue_generation: result.status ?? null,
+    confidence_band: result.confidence_band ?? null,
+    promotion_allowed: false,
+    auto_promotion_blocked: true,
+    requires_human_adjudication: true,
+    reason_codes: reasonCodesFromResult(result),
+    reason_families: reasonFamiliesFromResult(result),
+    source_evidence: sourceEvidence,
+    allowed_decision_statuses: DECISION_STATUS_OPTIONS,
+    allowed_decision_reason_codes: allowedDecisionReasonCodes({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      rubric,
+    }),
+    downstream_action_options: DOWNSTREAM_ACTION_OPTIONS,
+    decision_schema_ref: DEFAULT_PATHS.decisionSchemaOut,
+  };
+}
+
+function buildTaxonomyReviewTask({
+  task,
+  taskIndex,
+  paths,
+  rubric,
+}) {
+  const categoryId = categoryForTaxonomyTask(task);
+  const queueLane = 'semantic_review';
+  const riskTier = MEDIUM_RISK_TIER;
+  const reviewTaskId = `semrev:1335:taxonomy:${slugify(task.review_task_id)}`;
+  const pointer = `/review_tasks/${taskIndex}`;
+  const sourceEvidence = sourceEvidenceForTaxonomyTask({ task, paths, pointer });
+
+  return {
+    review_task_id: reviewTaskId,
+    queue_category: categoryId,
+    queue_lane: queueLane,
+    review_state: 'unresolved',
+    source_kind: 'taxonomy_canonicalization_review_task',
+    source_review_task_id: task.review_task_id ?? null,
+    source_validator_route: 'taxonomy_review_queue',
+    required_reviewer_role: task.required_reviewer_role ?? 'taxonomy_owner',
+    reviewer_agreement_requirement: reviewerAgreementRequirement({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      queueLane,
+    }),
+    priority: priorityForTask({ categoryId, riskTier, queueLane }),
+    risk_tier: riskTier,
+    predicate: null,
+    status_at_queue_generation: task.review_state ?? null,
+    confidence_band: null,
+    promotion_allowed: false,
+    auto_promotion_blocked: true,
+    requires_human_adjudication: true,
+    reason_codes: uniqueSorted(task.reason_codes ?? []),
+    reason_families: ['taxonomy_canonicalization'],
+    source_evidence: sourceEvidence,
+    allowed_decision_statuses: DECISION_STATUS_OPTIONS,
+    allowed_decision_reason_codes: allowedDecisionReasonCodes({
+      categoryId,
+      riskTier,
+      rubric,
+    }),
+    downstream_action_options: DOWNSTREAM_ACTION_OPTIONS,
+    decision_schema_ref: DEFAULT_PATHS.decisionSchemaOut,
+  };
+}
+
+function queueableValidatorResults(triangulationValidatorResult) {
+  const fixtureResults = Array.isArray(triangulationValidatorResult?.fixture_results)
+    ? triangulationValidatorResult.fixture_results
+    : [];
+  const rawCandidateResults = Array.isArray(triangulationValidatorResult?.raw_candidate_results)
+    ? triangulationValidatorResult.raw_candidate_results
+    : [];
+
+  return [
+    ...fixtureResults
+      .map((result, index) => ({ result, resultKind: 'fixture_results', resultIndex: index }))
+      .filter(({ result }) => ['review_required', 'blocked_quarantined'].includes(result.validator_route)),
+    ...rawCandidateResults
+      .map((result, index) => ({ result, resultKind: 'raw_candidate_results', resultIndex: index }))
+      .filter(({ result }) => ['review_required', 'blocked_quarantined'].includes(result.validator_route)),
+  ];
+}
+
+function buildReviewTasks({ inputs, paths, rubric }) {
+  const validatorTasks = queueableValidatorResults(inputs.triangulationValidatorResult)
+    .map(({ result, resultKind, resultIndex }) => buildValidatorReviewTask({
+      result,
+      resultKind,
+      resultIndex,
+      paths,
+      rubric,
+    }));
+  const taxonomyTasks = (inputs.taxonomyReviewQueue?.review_tasks ?? [])
+    .map((task, taskIndex) => buildTaxonomyReviewTask({
+      task,
+      taskIndex,
+      paths,
+      rubric,
+    }));
+
+  return [...validatorTasks, ...taxonomyTasks]
+    .sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.review_task_id, right.review_task_id));
+}
